description: Complete Journey toilet-tissue coupon campaign 18. All-household category sales were USD 5669.07 in weeks 45–52 versus USD 5221.50 in weeks 37–44. Matched category redemptions were 8 versus 2 (+6, +300.0%).

seasonality_control.method: Difference-in-differences in percentage points. Subtract the unweighted mean control-category sales change from the toilet-tissue sales change. Each change compares total retailer sales including returns in the same eight-week windows. The reported range spans the mean-adjusted and median-adjusted lifts.
seasonality_control.selection: Household paper and hygiene product types in GROCERY with zero campaign-18 coupon-eligible products.
